name: n8n

database.label: Bundled SQLite by default; PostgreSQL is strongly recommended for production or multi-worker (queue mode) setups

resourceFootprint.notes: 1 GB RAM / 1 core is a solid baseline for a personal automation instance with a moderate number of active workflows. AI-agent nodes, large data transformations and high-frequency triggers increase memory use; scale out with queue mode and extra worker containers for heavier workloads.

dockerComposeSnippet:
services:
  n8n:
    image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:latest
    container_name: n8n
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5678:5678"
    environment:
      - N8N_SECURE_COOKIE=false
      - GENERIC_TIMEZONE=Europe/Sofia
    volumes:
      - n8n_data:/home/node/.n8n

volumes:
  n8n_data:
descriptionEn: n8n is a fair-code workflow automation platform that combines a visual, node-based builder with the flexibility to drop in custom JavaScript/Python code where needed. It ships with 400+ integrations, native AI-agent nodes, and can be fully self-hosted with no per-execution pricing, unlike most commercial iPaaS tools.
descriptionBg: n8n е fair-code платформа за автоматизация на работни процеси, съчетаваща визуален конструктор с блокове с гъвкавостта да добавиш собствен JavaScript/Python код при нужда. Предлага над 400 интеграции, вградени AI-agent блокове и може да бъде изцяло self-hosted без такси на изпълнение, за разлика от повечето комерсиални iPaaS инструменти.
taglineEn: Self-hosted workflow automation with visual building and custom code.
taglineBg: Self-hosted автоматизация на работни процеси с визуален конструктор и собствен код.
